{{Top|leg}}
A '''Class B spacesuit''' was a type of [[Environment suit/Legends|spacesuit]], a life support uniform used to survive in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] or otherwise uninhabitable areas. The rated duration of [[Extra Vehicular Activity]] for a Class B spacesuit was inferior to one [[Standard minute/Legends|minute]].
